preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 20) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(N_line) <= 20000 for N_line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1])
preconditions.description: Each of the next T lines contains an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 20000) representing the number to check.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(['wins' if str(N) == str(N)[::-1] else 'loses' for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]]])
postconditions.description: For each number N, output 'wins' if the string representation of N is equal to its reverse (palindrome), otherwise output 'loses'.
